purpose: One observed gardening interaction while maintaining needs and responsibilities; preserve the goal across deferral.
input_authority: Independent screen_admit per action; this service never grants input authority.
recovery: Inspect existing need interactions. Failed remedies defer gardening without a purchase, placement, construction or approval prerequisite.
continuity_rules: one fresh exact-target affordance at a time
explicit player override and critical needs still win
verified per-target outcomes only; no blind cancellation
Opt-in fertilizer_workflow applies the same pocket inventory prerequisite to resumed tasks; no bypass through task_continuity

fertilizer_workflow.enrollment: Explicit current-capture gardening.fertilizer_workflow with verified selected Sim, plant targets, and inventory stock
fertilizer_workflow.prerequisite: Fertilizer in GROUND or HOUSEHOLD_INVENTORY does not count as personally carried; exact observed transfer into SIM_INVENTORY plus readback before fertilizing
fertilizer_workflow.batch: Only select native FERTILIZE_ALL if genuinely enabled and personal inventory holds sufficient stock; otherwise one observed exact-target FERTILIZE
fertilizer_workflow.continuity: Existing task_continuity player's goal, queue origin, duplicate guard and verified per-plant outcomes outrank new work
fertilizer_workflow.authority: One proposal per pass; never executes keyboard/mouse, purchases, saves or cancels.
fertilizer_workflow.waiting_behavior: While stock missing, target cooling down or picker absent: one observed gardening maintenance action may be selected, without changing verified fertilization progress; exact player-task continuity never falls back.

sourcing.activation: Opt-in nested fertilizer_workflow.sourcing only when selected Sim pocket lacks stock; after sourcing reobserve actual pocket inventory
sourcing.eligibility: Current actor/capture/queue/needs/player; only observed affordable and unreserved inputs; one source action
